DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE OF COMPLAINT AS TO DEFENDANT DOES 1 THROUGH 10

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT - (1) THE REPORT OF MICHAEL FOOR, PARTITION REFEREE, IS HEREBY APPROVED AND ALL HIS ACTS AS PARTITION REFEREE ARE CONFIRMED; (2) THE SALE OF THE REAL PROPERTY LOCATED AT 647 TERESITA BOULEVARD, SAN FRANCISCO, CA, TO IAN FIJOLEK AND JESSICA FIJOLEK FOR THE SUM OF ONE MILLIOR THREE HUNDRED EIGHTY-FIVE THOUSAND ($1,385,000.00) DOLLARS IS HEREBY APPROVED AND CONFIRMED; (3) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS ORDERED TO PAY TO HIMSELF OUT OF THE PROCEEDS OF THE SALE OF THE REAL PROPERTY THE SUM OF EIGHT HUNDRED FIFTY ($850.00) DOLLARS FOR HIS SERVICES IN THIS MATTER; (4) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS ORDERD TO REIMBURSE PLAINTIFF OUT OF THE PROCEEDS OF THE SALE OF THE REAL PROPERTY THE SUM OF $21,689.30, WHICH SUMS WERE SPENT BY PLAINTIFF TO MAINTAIN AND PERSERVE THE PROPERTY DURING AND BEFORE THE PENDENCY OF THIS PROCEEDINGS; (5) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS ORDERED TO REIMBURSE PLAINTIFF OUT OF THE PROCEEDS OF THE SALE OF THE PROPERTY THE SUM OF $7,574.50, ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS INCURRED BY PLAINTIFF IN BRINGING THIS ACTION; (6) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS ORDERED TO DISBURSE FROM THE PROCEEDS OF THE SALE THE SUM OF THIRTY FOUR THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED TWENTY FIVE ($34,625.00) DOLLARS TO LAMISSE DROUBI, AND THE SUM OF THIRTY FOUR THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED TWENTY-FIVE ($34,625.00) DOLLARS TO COLDWELL BANKER PREVIEWS INTERNATIONAL, HEREBY APPROVED AS COMMISSIONS TO SAID REALTORS; (7) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS ORDERED TO DISBURSE TO THE PERSONS AND ENTITIES THE SUMS DUE THEM AS SHOWN ON EXHIBIT E ATTACHED TO THE MOVING PAPERS HEREIN AND ATTACHED TO THIS JUDGMENT AS EXHIBIT A; AND (8) THE PARTITION REFEREE IS FURTHER ORDERD TO DISBURSE THE REMAINING SUMS ONE HALF TO PLAINTIFF FRANCES SUSAN HELLER AND ONE HALF TO DEFENDANT DEBORAH HELLER.
